01.name: MoveToLocation
field_names: moveMovement: 1 when arg5 == 0 (the 7th dword is flag(e) = sete)
01.notes: two senders of the same shapes: opcode 0x01 (ground click, 7 dwords) and, when the pawn is on a vehicle, opcode 0x5C MoveToLocationInVehicle (vehicle id + 6 dwords)

variants.name: MoveBackwardToLocation
variants.notes: opcode 0x01 with 6 dwords (no moveMovement), the same opcode MoveToLocation writes with 7; no NWindow caller (the Engine's own controller calls both)
